title: Text viewer, pane customization, and release notes
notes: Added an in-pane text viewer ("View file") for quickly viewing, and optionally editing, text files without leaving fman or waiting on an external editor.
Added commands to hide/show the Size and Modified columns per pane, for people who mostly care about file names.
The window title now shows both panes' current paths, and updates live as you navigate.

Added pane font size zoom (Alt+Up / Alt+Down, plus a palette-only Reset) so you can make file listings bigger or smaller on the fly. On Windows and Linux, "go to parent directory" moved from Alt+Up to Ctrl+Up to make room for this.
Added "Show only active pane" / "Show all panes" commands to temporarily collapse the dual-pane layout down to a single pane.
Added an in-app Release Notes viewer, reachable from the command palette, so you can browse past releases without leaving fman.
